analysis_method.auc: trapezoidal integration of the same piecewise-linear curves over the common observed interval; no extrapolation
analysis_method.common_interval: max(first validation times) to min(planned target, both actual totals)
analysis_method.final_delta: reported final validation loss A1 minus A0 at each completed arm endpoint
analysis_method.validation_curve: piecewise-linear interpolation between observed validation points indexed by cumulative CUDA-event seconds
